crossRefs.note: Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish…
Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir, and fought against it.
From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)

parallels.note: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)

people.name: Debir
people.line: Canaanite city captured by Joshua and Caleb's family.

translations.web: He went up against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.
translations.bsb: From there he marched against the inhabitants of Debir (formerly known as Kiriath-sepher).
translations.kjv: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher.
translations.asv: And he went up thence against the inhabitants of Debir: now the name of Debir beforetime was Kiriath-sepher.
